latest_release.body: [![GitHub Downloads (specific asset, specific tag)](https://shields.io/github/downloads/markterence/discord-quest-completer/2025.10.07/discord-quest-completer-win32-x64-2025.10.07.zip)](https://github.com/markterence/discord-quest-completer/releases/download/2025.10.07/discord-quest-completer-win32-x64-2025.10.07.zip) ## Update Full update details here: https://github.com/markterence/discord-quest-completer/discussions/12 - Update build for Perplexity quest (Comet). The application name is called "Comet" - Game list is now being dynamically fetched. A bundled game list is still present as fallback. (#8) - Improved searching of games. Using [Fuse.js](https://github.com/krisk/fuse) (fuzzy searching library) This update also include a few improvements on main application and changes on the dummy-exe. - Show dummy executable window. Can still be hidden/minimized to tray from the app's system tray context menu. (#6) - Game list is fetched from this repository's Github Pages and then if it fails will fetch directly from Discord. - New logo/app icon rather than using Tauri's default icon/logo. ---- ## What's Changed ### Other Changes * V1 patches by @markterence in https://github.com/markterence/discord-quest-completer/pull/11 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/markterence/discord-quest-completer/compare/2025.09.13...2025.10.07 ----- #### Disclaimer This tool is intended for educational purposes and personal use.
